Production game portrait animation SPRITE SHEET, 2048 x 2048, exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, exactly SIXTEEN equal square cells, no gutters, no dividers, no text or numbering. Preserve face, hair, clothing, colors and proportions precisely.

Dark navy magical library ambience fills every pixel of each cell; opaque background, no transparency. Premium clean anime card-game painted art. Keep all body/hair inside each cell, no cross-cell effects.

Critical: these are successive small increments of ONE continuous animation, never separate illustrations or pose samples. Frame 1 and frame 16 must have identical neutral face, camera, silhouette and lighting so this joins other animations cleanly. Small smooth changes, no zoom, no camera shifts, no cutaways. Background identical each cell. No frame borders, no labels.
